function.description: Read a Uniswap v3 pool's live state: tokens, fee tier, current tick, price and liquidity. Give a pool address, OR token_a + token_b + fee to locate one. A pair with no pool yet is reported, not invented. Read-only. protocol='v4' reads ANY v4 pool: by token_id (the pool of that position), by the full PoolKey (token_a, token_b, fee, tick_spacing, hooks), or a launchpad pool by its token; it adds the fees and the last 24 hours of swaps, volume and LP fees.
function.name: defi_data_lp_pool_info

chain.description: Chain to read a Uniswap v3 pool on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, bnb, solana.

fee.description: Fee tier in hundredths of a bip: 100, 500, 3000, 10000.

hooks.description: v4 only: the PoolKey's hook address; omit for a pool with no hook.

protocol.description: v3, or v4. A v4 pool has no address: give token_id (the pool of that position), OR the full PoolKey (token_a + token_b + fee + tick_spacing, and hooks when it has one), OR only token_a + token_b for a Pons graduated pool (the other side is 'native').

tick_spacing.description: v4 only: the PoolKey's tick spacing. Giving it names the PoolKey in full.

token_id.description: v4 only: read the pool of this position NFT.
